verdicts.composition_axis: LawGP helps on the held-out composition only for the electrospun PVDF/GO data (+0.58 impulse, +0.58 frequency, five-start GP); the gain is about zero on PVDF-TrFE (-0.01) and printed PVDF (+0.00, two devices) and strongly negative on the held-out preload of the stretched films (-0.50 G/PVDF/G, -1.64 P(VDF-TrFE)).
verdicts.salama_frequency_axis: On 1 to 5 Hz the six curves rise and level off: BIC prefers one Lorentzian on 6/6, AICc the first-order high-pass rise on 6/6, and f0 sits at its upper bound on 2/6; five frequencies from 1 to 5 Hz cannot separate a resonance from a high-pass rise.
verdicts.park_sampling: Park statistics come from 5 Hz samples of the traced curves; the sampled maxima fall short of the printed resonance peaks by a median 7 % and at most 30 %.
verdicts.park_restarts: Park GP and LawGP scores are reported with the optimizer restarted from five starts (a2_common.gp(4)); with one start the plain GP falls into a near-interpolating optimum on the G/PVDF/G spectra (LOO R2 0.10 against 0.86). The Park jackknife+ intervals use the one-start models.

repeat_pass.description: second pass with looser colour thresholds and a narrower column window

cross_figure.description: same numbers read from Fig. 10a/b (against force) and Fig. 10e/f (against GO); includes overlap and fitted-line contamination in a/b and any plotting inconsistency of the source

source_inconsistency_candidates.description: conditions where Fig. 10a/b shows a fully visible marker (not a line crossing) whose value differs from the same condition in Fig. 10e/f by more than 10 %; checked by eye for (2.5 wt%, 0.3 N, 10 Hz): magenta marker near 1650 V/g in 10a, yellow marker near 1050 V/g in 10e. The csv keeps the 10e/f value.

cross_figure_over_25pct.description: every condition whose Fig. 10a/b reading and Fig. 10e/f reading differ by more than 25 %. Part of each gap is overlap of markers and fitted lines in 10a/b (reading 'errbar_mid' or a small marker) and part may be a plotting inconsistency of the source; the csv keeps the 10e/f value, and a9_external.py reports the scores with these cells dropped as a sensitivity.

repeat_pass.description: second pass with a looser colour threshold, darker highlight cut and narrower column window

second_figure_PBC5.description: PBC-5 curve read a second time, independently, from the Fig. 4b waveform (median pulse peak per force band)

shi2025.occlusion_note: partly hidden markers read from one visible edge plus the radius; reading method per row in the csv column 'reading'
